9fd3e49c82f1f145.c: We ranked 24 chat apps, our own included, from S (best in class) to F (missing or unusable) in twelve sections, then gave each an overall tier. Every placement has a one-line reason, and every app has a full comparison page with dated sources.

8e1e4209df4e3a2f.c: We tried hard not to be: SerikaCord is never placed above an app that is clearly better in a section, and it lands in C or D where it is weak. Disagree? Check the sources on each comparison page, and tell us at support@serika.dev.

540617b11b412f63.c: Each section is judged on what a normal person or community gets today, not on roadmaps. S means best in class, A excellent, B good, C mixed, D weak, and F missing or unusable. A tier can be empty. Inside a tier, apps are listed from best to worst.

Facts come from each app's own website, documentation, source code, app store listings and policies, plus reputable press and security research. Where we couldn't verify something, we didn't count it. Every comparison page lists its sources with dates.

Matrix and XMPP are ranked as networks with their best-known apps (Element and Movim). Kloak shut down in October 2026, so it is F everywhere; its page records what it offered. Things change quickly, so treat this as a snapshot.

10ed938a2537272d: Webhookトークンはメッセージを送信する唯一の認証です。秘密に保ってください — URLを持つ誰もがメッセージを投稿できます。トークンが漏洩した場合、Webhookを削除して再作成してください。
d3725410b3a989ed: メッセージを送信できますが、メッセージを読み取ったり、ボイスに参加したり、Gatewayイベントを受信したりできません。メッセージを読み取ったり反応する必要がある場合は、ボットを使用してください。両方を組み合わせることもできます：イベントを読み取るボットと、ボットがアクセスできないチャンネルに投稿するWebhook。
